question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Insist
solution:
The correct answer is: **Persist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insist"** means to demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal. (ज़ोर देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **insisted **on paying for the meal despite our protests.
 
 
 
• **"Persist"** means to continue firmly in an opinion or a course of action despite difficulty or opposition. (दृढ़ रहना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **persisted **in his efforts to learn the guitar despite many setbacks.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Insist'** is **'Persist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resist** (प्रतिरोध करना): To withstand the action or effect of something.

 
 
• **Example:** He couldn't **resist **the temptation to eat the chocolate cake.
 
 
 
• **Heist** (डकैती): A robbery or theft.
 
 
• **Example: **The bank **heist **was executed with precision by the thieves.
 
 
 
• **Assist** (मदद करना): To help someone by doing a share of the work.
 
 
• **Example:** The nurse **assists **the doctor during surgeries.
